pages.text: Archers punish travelers who focus only on the largest threat. They support ogre groups from range and are most dangerous when a palisade or another ogre keeps you occupied.$(br2)An Archer may drop its buckler, a hands-slot relic useful to bow users and anyone tired of incoming arrows.
Break line of sight, then choose when to cross the open ground.

pages.title: Close Quarters
pages.text: An Archer is lanky and hits lightly, but it will not stand still when you close in. A wide sweep catches everything in front of it, and a heavier swing follows, both thrown while it keeps walking.$(br2)Neither hurts like an Ogre's club. The arrows are the danger; the swings only buy it room.

pages.title: Mounted
pages.text: Some Archers ride Mudsnout Boars. A mounted Archer cannot steer; the boar carries it wherever the boar wants to go. It twists in place to shoot, but only inside a cone ahead of the boar, so get to its side or behind it.

pages.title: Buckler
pages.text: An Archer carries its own buckler: one arrow in four glances off it, which includes yours. Thrown spears still get through, and so does anything that is not an arrow.
